picks.editorial_note: MIT's Regina Barzilay and Jim Collins won the inaugural Pritzker Prize for AI in Science Research Excellence for pioneering AI-enabled antibiotic discovery, a landmark recognition validating AI's role in addressing the global antibiotic resistance crisis.
picks.title: Regina Barzilay and Jim Collins win Pritzker Prize for AI and Science Research Excellence for work in AI-enabled antibiotic discovery

picks.editorial_note: Nebraska will lead cybersecurity for FabAID, a five-year, $24.5M NSF-funded national infrastructure project to support AI-driven science — a major federal investment with broad cross-institutional reach.
picks.title: University to lead cybersecurity for national Fabric for AI-Driven Science project

picks.editorial_note: Boston University joined a $39.5M ARPA-H consortium with Philips, Johns Hopkins, and Weill Cornell to build AI-enabled robotic catheter technology for remote stroke treatment, pairing significant federal funding with a high-value industry-academic-clinical partnership.
picks.title: Brink Bites: Robotic Stroke Surgery, Curbing Junk Food Sales, and American Attitudes On Data Center Construction

picks.editorial_note: HKUST and HSBC signed a strategic framework deepening a near-decade partnership to advance AI and financial innovation through HSBC's new AI & Emerging Technology Institute, a notable academia-industry alliance in financial AI.
picks.title: HKUST and HSBC Forge Strategic Partnership to Advance AI, Emerging Technologies and Financial Innovation
picks.university: Hong Kong Univ. of Science and Technology

picks.editorial_note: The DOE's release of 'Genesis Agent Skills,' developed with Fermilab, operationalizes agentic AI across the national Genesis Mission for scientific machine learning — a concrete step in federal AI research policy with cross-lab impact.
picks.title: ‘Genesis Agent Skills’ release to support innovation across the Genesis Mission

picks.editorial_note: Cambridge researchers used an AI-guided design technique to create a broad-spectrum bird flu vaccine achieving complete protection against diverse variants in animal trials, a significant scientific advance with real public-health stakes.
picks.title: Scientists are using AI to develop superior vaccines against viruses threatening global health

picks.editorial_note: A Case Western-led, NIH-funded multi-institutional team will combine large-scale health data, satellite imaging, and AI to study environmental contributions to Alzheimer's and dementia, a scientifically ambitious effort with major public-health implications.
picks.title: Case Western Reserve-led team to study how the environment contributes to Alzheimer’s and dementia | CWRU Newsroom | Case Western Reserve University

picks.editorial_note: Anthropic's pledge of up to 5% of its equity (potentially $100 billion) alongside SpaceX's giveaways raises major policy questions about how AI windfall wealth should be distributed to the public, a story with outsized financial and governance stakes.
picks.title: Billions in SpaceX, Anthropic Stock Pledged to the Public. Who Benefits? - Georgetown University

picks.editorial_note: ANU secured Google.org funding to modernize its widely-used SPEC fusion simulation tool with AI, an industry-academic partnership advancing AI applications in clean energy research.
picks.title: ANU receives Google funding to boost fusion energy research with AI

picks.editorial_note: Tel Aviv University and Stanford researchers showed AI models can learn general predictive skills purely from self-generated synthetic data, a conceptually significant result for reducing AI's dependence on real-world training data.
picks.title: AI Learns to Predict the World Without Ever Seeing It
